quest.title: Zip Along (According to Safe Cart Operating Procedures)
quest.description: To repair the great wheel in the Veluriyam Mirage, you must obtain components that have been dropped in different locations. Klee said that a giant canyon appeared in the area they were investigating...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Go to the canyon Klee told you about

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Here it is, here it is! See? This canyon wasn't here before!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Just before the canyon appeared, I heard a faint sound, like something mechanical turning.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Ker-chunk, ker-chunk, ker-chunk!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Could it have been the Central Hub? Mm, that would mean this canyon appeared after it started spinning...
Hey, you... Oh, new guys, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, hey... Paimon didn't realize anyone else besides Idyia lived here!
You actually saw her? Hmph, she's barely shown her face since everything started falling apart here.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Excuse me for asking, but... who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Oh right, I didn't introduce myself. I'm Ferdinand. Me and my brothers look after this whole zone.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Well, we used to. Until this whole domain was... like, flipped upside-down, or whatever. The method we were using to make the carts and tracks stopped working after that...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Idyia is working on repairing the domain. We were just with her before coming here.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Really...? Huh. I assumed that she'd be curled up in a fetal position somewhere, hoping all her problems will magically disappear on their own... Good for her.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Anyway, I checked all the stations around the whole circuit...they've all conked out.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Conked out how? Would you mind elaborating a little for us?

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Uh... But aren't you just travelers who stumbled upon this place by accident?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Nuh-uh! I'm Mage Klee, Idyia's helper!

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: ...A Mage? You?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Allow me to explain...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You introduce yourselves to Ferdinand and explain what's happened...

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Okay, I gotcha... Well, right now, the more helpers we got, the better, I guess...

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Anyway, our first priority is to get the carts here up and running again.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Oh? And why is that?

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: The roads here twist and turn so much that the best way to get around is by riding the rail tracks instead...

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Lemme show you... This is what we use to make them. Did Idyia bring you up to speed on these things?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It is a Streaming Projector, right?

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Yep. Basically, we need something that we can put inside that'll make a cart for us.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Umm... like what? Can it be anything as long as it looks like a cart?

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Yeah, you could put it that way. But one other thing is that it has to be compatible with the tracks.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: So something like... a sedan chair, maybe? Hmm, but I'm not sure we have all the materials required to build one of those...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #How about you, {NICKNAME}? Any ideas?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, that would solve the issue of materials.

response.speaker: Ferdinand
response.text: Wood's no good. A rickety wooden cart would be too dangerous.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Really? ....Hey, everyone, come and see what Klee made!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Tada! Look, I made a cart!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow! Amazing work, Klee!

response.speaker: Ferdinand
response.text: Whoa... It fits the track like a glove, too!

response.speaker: Ferdinand
response.text: Plus... it's a heck of a lot cuter than the ones Idyia made!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Hee-hee, I just wanted to give it a try. Then suddenly, boom! There it was!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Paimon's gotta ask — what exactly did you make your cart from, Klee?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I used Jumpy Dumpty!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aha! Thought so...

response.speaker: Ferdinand
response.text: Hmm? Is there a problem, or something? If not, then let's get ready to leave.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's just... this cart is made from, um...

response.speaker: Ferdinand
response.text: It's a bomb or something, isn't it? Yeah, I gathered from your conversation that Jumpy Dumpty is a little more volatile than the cute name suggests.

response.speaker: Ferdinand
response.text: It's okay, though, 'cause the end product only takes on the general look of the source material. Uh, so to be more specific, while different materials have different properties, most of them aren't transferred to—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's okay! No need to delve into the theoretical stuff!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon just wanted to make sure we aren't about to end up like the, uh, "flying fish" of Starfell Lake...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Can we ride the cart now?

response.speaker: Ferdinand
response.text: In a moment. We need a Hydro Eidolon to power it up first.

response.speaker: Hydro Eidolon
response.text: Gurgle!

response.speaker: Ferdinand
response.text: Okay, she's ready to roll. Hop in!

choices.text: We just need to drive safely!
How about a castle with legs?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What kind of a suggestion is that? That would be way too complicated to make!

response.speaker: Ferdinand
response.text: Yeah... Sorry, I don't think we'd have the right materials for that.

talks.objective: Ride ahead on the rail tracks
Ride ahead on the rail tracks
Ride ahead on the rail tracks

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: The track is damaged up ahead. We need to make some repairs before we can go any further...

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Yep, looks like it's all reverted to a preprint state here.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Do you know why that happened?

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Everything in this domain starts as a preprint and only takes shape after being illuminated by the Streaming Projector.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: But the Hydro Eidolon that forms the tracks here has been trapped in the print...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: So someone needs to go into the preprint and rescue the Hydro Eidolon. Right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But the projector here's sealed off by a giant bubble.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: That's the Hydro Eidolon's way of protecting the device from damage... If the Streaming Projector broke, then we'd be seriously stuck.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aha! So for step one, we need Water Droplet to help!

dialogues.speaker: Hydro Eidolon
dialogues.text: Gurgle...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww, it seems to really like that name!

dialogues.speaker: Hydro Eidolon
dialogues.text: Gurgle!

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Um... Any volunteers for step two...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Leave that to us. We know what to do!

talks.objective: Save the Hydro Eidolon from the preprint
Ride ahead on the Choo-Choo Cart
Keep riding ahead on the Choo-Choo Cart

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oh, there's another spinny thing here... It's so big!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: But uh, not as big as the one we saw in the middle of this place. That one was HUGE!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I bet it's something super important... I remember what Kaeya said earlier!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Very good, Klee! You're using what you saw earlier to make observations, like a real adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Hmm, it appears to be a system that rotates to switch tracks.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: That's right. Originally, all you had to do was flip this switch, and the junction would rotate.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Hmph, but it seems Jeroney still hasn't fixed it yet. He sure talks big but when it comes to actually getting things done...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Is this "Jeroney" you mentioned one of your brothers?

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Yeah, when I talked to him about repairing the tracks, I suggested we start with the station, but he said we should start at the junction...

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Really, it made no difference which one we started with, but he just had to turn it into a huge argument... He always treats me like I'm a fool and disagrees with anything I say.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Hmph, let's see what he has to say now that I've already fixed the tracks.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: If you ask me, you're clearly a sharp person, Ferdinand.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Yes! Finally, someone who can recognize that rather than just shrugging off my ideas! Come on, let's make our way to the junction and see what he's up to. I bet he's still fretting over what to do.

talks.objective: Ride the cart ahead to look for Jeroney

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: *sigh* Everything will get better once we get the switcher working again.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Hmph, still stuck here just as I expected. Well, did you make any progress?

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: Didn't I already tell you? Just have the Hydro Eidolons fix the junction and then make a new cart. After that, we can use the junction to...

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: Wait a minute, how did you get here? It took a lot of effort for me to climb all the way up here.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: The answer is standing right in front of you.

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: Hah, yeah sure. Those travelers must have helped you.

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: You never get anything done on your own. You always get someone else's help, and then try to take the credit for yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: You're one to talk. What have you managed to accomplish, huh? You were here just moping around all day!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... They started arguing the moment they saw each other. But aren't they supposed to be brothers?

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: Hah, me? His brother? Hardly!

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: *sigh* Alright, Jeroney... That's enough.

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: Ugh, fine. I'd rather be focusing my efforts on fixing the track switch rather than arguing anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: You should calm down too, Ferdinand. Let's all focus on the situation at hand, any personal problems can be settled later.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: ...Fine.

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: I'm sorry you had to see that... My name's Jeroney. I'm one of the people responsible for taking care of this area.

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: I assume you're the ones who helped repair the tracks... Thank you very much, it means a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: No need to thank us. We're just trying to help Idyia restore the domain.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You explain the situation to Jeroney...

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: I see. Now that you and Ferdinand brought the cart up here, we'll need the Hydro Eidolons to fix the area below.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Them again, huh? Seems the Hydro Eidolons are really important around this place.

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: Yes, of course. Not only do they keep the junction turning, they operate practically everything else in the domain, too.

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: Alright, seems most of the tracks and junctions have been repaired now.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Yep. So maybe it's time you give credit where credit is due, hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: What, you think you deserve the credit!? If anything, we should be thanking these travelers.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Ugh, you... Well, either way, you're not the one getting any credit!

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: You're always quick to criticize my ideas and push your own, but you never actually get anything done.

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: And what about you? Don't forget that it was Haddo and I who took care of the mess that one time you impulsively tried one of your brilliant ideas!

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: Ah, speaking of Haddo... Wasn't he with you?

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: I left early this morning, I assumed he'd be with you.

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: Seriously? Couldn't you have at least looked to see where he was before you left!?

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Hey c'mon... You didn't see him either, so what's your excuse!?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: *whimper*...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Klee?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I don't get it...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Nobody did anything bad, why are they arguing?

response.speaker: Ferdinand
response.text: I, uh... I just don't like his smug attitude, that's all.

response.speaker: Jeroney
response.text: Who are you calling smug? If anything, you're the one who's making such a big fuss right now!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Alright, I think we've heard enough from you two.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: If you insist on bickering, then I'd suggest you go somewhere else, otherwise, I'll just cool you two off myself.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Now, come with me. I'd like to have a word with you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Don't be upset Klee... There are many complicated situations in this world which don't always have a logical explanation.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: As a passing traveler here, it's not my place to comment on their disputes...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: But in my experience, family issues can be the toughest to resolve.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems you don't like dealing with this kind of thing either, Kokomi.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: But... it's still not right.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I don't know how to explain my feelings...

response.speaker: Jeroney
response.text: I'm sorry, we've calmed down. We shouldn't argue in front of a child like that.

response.speaker: Ferdinand
response.text: We're sorry, Klee.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: It's okay...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Back to the topic at hand, weren't you about to go look for your brother, Haddo?

response.speaker: Jeroney
response.text: Ah, right. Our best guess is that he's somewhere around Torrential Twister.

response.speaker: Jeroney
response.text: We would have to use the junction to send the cart to another area.

response.speaker: Ferdinand
response.text: Sorry to trouble you again, but would you help us find him?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: As long as you promise not to argue.

response.speaker: Jeroney
response.text: Oh, all right...

choices.text: You don't like seeing people argue?

talks.objective: Ride the Choo-Choo Cart towards the Torrential Twister

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: Ah, I guessed you had repaired the tracks and stations as soon as I saw a cart come zipping along. *sickly cough*

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: Now that the tracks, station, and carts are all repaired, we're about ready to reopen Torrential Twister. It'll be good to see my design back in action again.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: *sigh* You're in no condition to be out running around like this, Haddo.

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: Yeah, but these are unusual circumstances... *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: That's true, but you should stop to think things through.

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: Exactly! If there's anything that needs to be done, you can just let Ferdinand and I take care of it.

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: Haha, you and Ferdinand? Together? It would be a miracle for you two to do anything together without fighting.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Hey! That's between Jeroney and me. No need to add fuel to the fire, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: I'm not trying to make trouble, I'm just saying... *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hey, Ferdinand...

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Oh, uh... Don't worry, we're not arguing, Klee. We're just, uh... discussing some things.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Are you and Jeroney worried about Haddo?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Why don't you just talk to him about it?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Kaeya's also worried about me sometimes, but he doesn't ever criticize me.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: You're right, but our relationship is much better than these guys.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Uh, well... our situation is a little different.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Really? How so?

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: We've been through this kind of thing before... if we didn't warn Haddo, then he wouldn't take it seriously and something would eventually happen.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: As his brothers, we have to help him...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: But it doesn't look like you're helping...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Maybe Klee doesn't understand everything...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: But my Mommy told me that you help someone to make THEM feel happy, not to make yourself happy.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Haddo sure doesn't look very happy. Why don't you ask him what he needs?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Klee's right, you know. You three need to open up and talk things through, you are brothers, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: I, uh... Ahem, I've always cared a lot about you, Haddo.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Just like when we were back in the desert... You suddenly passed out, and Jeroney and I started arguing. Eventually, all three of us ended up in this domain.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: I'm just worried that something similar could happen again. If you were to pass out and with nobody around to help you...

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: I know, but this domain is nowhere near as dangerous as the desert.

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: I was thinking that if I could handle these problems myself, then you two wouldn't have to argue about anything.

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: If it weren't for my poor health and lack of energy all the time, then I wouldn't have always been such a burden on you two.

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: No need to feel guilty, Haddo. This was our choice. The three of us love adventuring, no one is a burden on anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: Isn't that why we came up with the idea for this area? I would do the thinking, Ferdinand would use his muscle, and you would...

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: "Draw the blueprints and build tracks. It'll be a safe way to see all kinds of amazing scenery." Yes, that was the plan.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe. See? Doesn't it feel better to just get along?

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Hey what are ya tryin' to say!? You make it sound like I've only been trying to talk myself up.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: The Choo-Choo Cart is great, Ferdinand!

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Really?

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: You know, Klee... Having the cart zip along the tracks was my idea.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yeah, what an amazing idea. You're so smart!

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: Hey Klee, do you want to ride even more fun carts?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yay, let's ride more!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like all three of them are trying to win Klee's approval now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And Klee is loving it.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Klee hasn't realized it yet, but her innocent, childlike nature is very powerful. It can inspire and even help heal others.

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: Hey everyone, please come with me. We need to get the Hydro Eidolon in the cart to help us.

talks.objective: Ride the Choo-Choo Cart and go activate the tracks
Return to the Torrential Twister's Cart Platform

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Haddo and I have double-checked everything, it's all operating safely. You can go for a ride now!

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: Hold on a sec... Before we say goodbye, I have something I'd like to give you all.

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: It's a rock climbing rope. We used it on our adventures to climb mountains and traverse many places.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? But doesn't it mean a lot to you? Are you sure you want to give it to us?

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: Yes, of course. Please take it.

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: Thanks to Klee and everyone else's help, we realized that there is a special bond that keeps us together. Even though it's invisible, it's even more important than rope, and we can always hold on to it in tough situations.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Huh? I helped?

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: Yes, Klee. You were a big help.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Even bigger than that huge thing in the middle of this place?

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Yes, much bigger.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Wow, that's huge! I'm so happy!

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: By the way, have you ever seen anything like the Choo-Choo Cart in the outside world?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Nope! Today was the first time I rode anything like it.

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: Is that so? *cough* I guess I'm not surprised. Seems you won't find a Streaming Projector anywhere else.

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: Be sure to come back and ride the Choo-Choo Carts again while you still have the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yep! I will!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: That's so much fun! Klee can fly across the sky like a real mage now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Guess that... sort of makes sense?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait — but if being able to fly makes you a mage, what does that make Kaeya? Since he's here too...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Nothing, Kaeya's just the Master Thief. Don't you remember, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh right... Guess it slipped Paimon's mind.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Sorry to bother our young Mage, but there's something the Master Thief would like to report. Do you still remember our mission?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Uh-oh!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I was having so much fun that I almost forgot...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: We're supposed to be helping Idyia look for the missing components. But don't worry, I've already got one.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: You mean you snatched it when we weren't looking?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha, I didn't have to go that far.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: In fact, the component we were searching for was actually that orange rope. If anything, you could say it came right into our hands at the right time. Let's head back and give it to Idyia.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Aww, do we really have to go...?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Okay... Even though I want to keep playing, I know Idyia is really important!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: That's our wise mage... Don't worry, tonight you'll be able to see stars in the water and watch fish dance in the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, seems Kokomi's out of it after that ride... Her face is completely blank, and her lip was trembling while she was speaking. Maybe we should have a rest for a while.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Ah? I thought I was keeping my composure pretty well...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Don't worry, my mind is always spinning, I'm used to this! We should head back to Idyia.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: How about we hold hands, Miss General? Klee will give you energy!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: (Huh, after holding Klee's hand, the stars in the sky and the fish in the water have all disappeared. I must have been seeing things from riding in the cart... Whew.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm? What are you smiling about, Kokomi?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Huh? Oh, ah... Ahem, nothing... nothing at all.

talks.objective: Return to the Silver Bottle Courtyard

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Welcome back! Well? Any good news? Ah! Don't tell me! You've taken care of all the problems and now I don't have to do anything!?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah, we even rode the Choo-Choo Cart! Do you wanna come ride too?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Uh, but maybe you'll have to wait till tomorrow. I'm a little tired now...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Seems she had a little too much fun and now she's about to crash. Haha, I think it's time for a rest.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Good idea, I think we could all use some down time. Thanks for giving me some energy, Klee.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Then we'll see you later.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Bye, Klee.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Bye, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight! Bye, everyone!

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Well, it sounds like our young mage enjoyed herself. I'm happy that she had a good time.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: So, back to the missing component. Did you bring it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You bet! Kaeya said that the missing component was this orange climbing rope.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Ah, it just occurred to me that you probably ran into the three brothers while you were in the canyon.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: If I remember correctly, the two eldest brothers were taking their sickly younger brother on adventures, when they ran into a sandstorm and ended up here.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: They were all arguing with one other when they first arrived, but it wasn't long before they broke down and were huddled together in tears.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: *sigh* They sure must have a lot of energy to keep up their bickering and adventuring every day. I'm a little worried about them, yet quite envious of all that energy...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: You almost sound as if you're reminiscing about old friends, Idyia.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Yes, I've known them for quite some time, after all... But I seldom go to that area.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: #You can hold on to the rope for now, {NICKNAME}. I have no use for it until we have the other components.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: By the way, Eula and Collei have also returned, but I'm afraid they weren't able to make much headway.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: They mentioned that they would like to head to the jungle north of here once you have all rested up.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Understood.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Now that I've told you everything, I'll go rest... Uh, I mean, I'll go and check on the situation in the remaining two areas.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Do you need me to accompany you?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Oh! No, it's alright. You've already accomplished a lot today, you should rest up.

choices.text: Yep, we took care of everything.

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Be sure to come back and visit Torrential Twister again... I hope you enjoyed it!

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: Thanks again. I have a feeling we'll get along much better now that we've learned to open up to each other.

dialogues.speaker: Jeroney
dialogues.text: I suppose some things are simpler than they appear... The real problem all along was actually us.

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: Hey, imagine if we could build our tracks all over the world. Traveling would be so much easier! *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Ah, so the Hydro Eidolon was locked up in that chest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, it's completely empty.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Weee! Look, Klee can fly just like Paimon now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is way more exciting than how Paimon usually flies!

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Sometimes I can't help but get angry just thinking of Jeroney. You should have seen him back in the sandstorm. I suggested we go east, and he argued that we should go west...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You were in sandstorm!? What happened after that?

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: We separated and each went our own way...

dialogues.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogues.text: Lucky for us, we stumbled across this domain, otherwise I'm sure we would have been buried in the sand.

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: Good, Torrential Twister is ready to run now. Let's go to the station at the start of the track.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Woo-hoooo! Weeeee!!!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like Klee's having the most fun.
